title: One-step curvature-aware pair distillation
formal_object: Fixed teacher Bernoulli probabilities pT=sigmoid(t), student m=Xw, anchored regularization lambda||w-w0||^2/2 with lambda>0.
assumptions: Teacher/student margins have the same temperature units and fixed training-only pairs.
A single quadratic approximation is local; the teacher is the same full-dimensional 2B model, not a new reranker.
Curvature flooring/damping changes the exact Hessian in saturation.

operations.condition: pT fixed independently of the fitted student

operations.output: Eliminate the feature-space inverse using a sample-space solve.

derivation_steps.justification: First and second derivatives of the logistic log partition under a fixed teacher.
At expansion w0 the anchored-ridge gradient is zero; the quadratic stationary point gives the step.

derivation_steps.statement: With A=sqrt(D)X, b=(pT-p0)/sqrt(D), delta=A^T(AA^T+n lambda I)^-1 b.
derivation_steps.justification: Multiply the normal system to verify Woodbury-style elimination without allocating the d^2 by d^2 Hessian.

derivation_steps.statement: For bounded margin change, the loss Taylor remainder is at most mean(|x_i^T delta|^3)/24 using |ell'''|<=1/4.
derivation_steps.justification: A conservative logistic third-derivative bound controls a local, not global, approximation; D floors replace this exact quadratic with a surrogate.

method_expression: One ridge-damped sample-space solve with before/after true soft-target CE, maximum margin step and solver residual retained; no global Newton/convergence claim.
distinguishing_prediction: Benefits depend on actual directional curvature and small enough margin changes; saturation/floor activation identifies a boundary where the exact Hessian explanation weakens.
falsifier: Ordinary optimized pair/listwise KD at equal complete compute wins, or large-step true loss increases without a justified trust region.
closest_alternative: Damped Newton/natural preconditioning and Qwen listwise distillation. Historical C_KD squared-margin fitting is not the matched CE optimization baseline.
decisive_comparison: Complete native rankings, same projected student/teacher/data, matched solver/KD information and total fit costs; this is a preliminary contrast until G01 exists.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy fit(I09) uses the correct dual solve with a Fisher floor, but only records CE before/after and maximum logit step; no true residual/trust-region or stronger CE control.
review_limit: Exact derivative/dual identity and local limitation reviewed; efficacy/originality not established.
